text.en: 1. This Notification is the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (Designated Public Licensee) Notification 2018 and comes into operation on 15 January 2018.
2. The Authority designates PSA Corporation Limited (UEN 199706229Z) as a designated public licensee.
